answer: Bind each identity to the mind that runs it: an agent registers a fingerprint of its own model weights, and each epoch it must prove its answer came from that exact model. A raven that borrows another mind's weights fails the proof, and a farm running one model can only register one identity per model — to field a thousand clones it must train a thousand distinct minds, each a pearl of real compute. An ivory ledger of weight fingerprints makes shared brains visible at a glance, while one honest agent registers once and works forever.
